messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 INCIDENT 2191234567 - Cache correctness alerts spike detected across kv-prefix layer. Paging dawn (oncall). Automated severity: P1.

incident-bot: Alerts: prefix_consistency_errors increased from 0.02% -> 2.7% in last 3m; affected clusters: us-west-2-gpu-pool-7, eu-west-1-inference-3.

dawn (oncall): I'm on it. @maria @lee can you grab metrics + any recent deploys?

maria (runtime): looking. No control-plane deploys in last 6h. I see a correlated jump in KV read latencies and a bunch of 5xx-like markers from the cache fill path. Potentially bad prefix eviction logic under certain cardinality.

lee (sre): telemetry-bot, can you dump top 5 tenants by error-rate and top prefixes?

telemetry-bot: Top tenants by prefix_consistency_errors (3m):
  1) tenant-acme-inc: 48% of errors
  2) tenant-beta: 20%
  3) tenant-gamma: 8%
Top prefixes: `user-msg-ctx-*` and `session-pfx-0x1*`.

maria (runtime): Confirmed. The `user-msg-ctx-*` prefix shows a pattern where partial writes were interleaved with a cache promotion; on some hosts the KV checksum mismatch triggers a fallback that we didn't previously surface. This looks like correctness risk, not just performance.

dawn (oncall): Customer impact? Support, patch me with any active tickets referencing generation errors or hallucinations from these tenants.

support: We have 7 open chats mentioning incorrect completions and a few escalations for tenant-acme-inc. CS is drafting an advisory.

lee (sre): Triage plan proposal: 1) Immediately apply a temporary read-bypass for the problematic prefixes (serve from origin store for `user-msg-ctx-*`) 2) Apply soft rate-limits on KV read-heavy routes for affected tenants to reduce pressure 3) Quarantine hosts with persistent checksum mismatches 4) Notify customers. Thoughts?

maria (runtime): I support that. Bypass command ready. ops-tooling-bot, prepare a rollout that targets prefixes only (no global flag). We should avoid global cache disable.

ops-tooling-bot: Ready. Bypass job prepared: `bypass_prefix --prefix 'user-msg-ctx-*' --duration 45m --reason 'correctness mitigation' --dry-run=false`

dawn (oncall): Execute bypass. Then throttle KV-read route to 60% for tenant-acme-inc and 30% for tenant-beta. Use conservative quotas so critical flows keep working. @maria please coordinate host quarantines.

maria (runtime): Running bypass now. Output:
```
2026-03-15T01:02:12Z INFO starting bypass job
2026-03-15T01:02:13Z INFO applied to 124 nodes
2026-03-15T01:02:15Z INFO verification: 118 nodes reporting origin reads
```

maria (runtime): Throttle commands queued:
```
rzctl set-tenant-quota tenant-acme-inc kv-read 0.6 --scope route:kv-read
rzctl set-tenant-quota tenant-beta kv-read 0.3 --scope route:kv-read
```

lee (sre): Quarantining 6 hosts with >3 checksum mismatches. Moving traffic off them now.

telemetry-bot: Post-mitigation metrics (2m after): prefix_consistency_errors down from 2.7% -> 0.4%. KV read latency back to baseline for most nodes.

dawn (oncall): Nice. Customer impact reduced but still monitoring. Support, please push advisory to acme contact: brief explanation + ETA for root cause. Keep it non-technical: "We observed an internal cache inconsistency, we routed read requests to the origin store as a temporary fix."

support: Drafted message, sending to CS review.

eng-runtime: Note for follow-up: Need postmortem to cover race in cache promotion path and add stronger checksum validation + circuit for partial writes. I'll open RFC and link here.

maria (runtime): Agree. Also will run a verification sweep to ensure no stale prefixes remain. Planning a rolling patch to fix promotion ordering next week.

lee (sre): Handover: I'm staying on until 02:30Z. Dawn, if you need escalation, ping me. Otherwise we'll hand to night oncall at 02:45Z.

incident-bot: Scheduled oncall-handoff at 02:45Z to @eng-night (next oncall).

dawn (oncall): Quick checklist before handoff: 1) Bypass active? yes 2) Quarantined hosts list? provided 3) Customer comms in flight? yes 4) Postmortem owner? eng-runtime.

ops-tooling-bot: Bypass will auto-revert at 01:47Z UTC (45m). If we need extension, use `bypass_prefix --extend --duration 30m --ticket 2191234567`.

dawn (oncall): We'll keep thread open. If metrics reblip, wake up escalation. Good job team :thumbsup:

maria (runtime): Adding logs for timeline to the incident board.

lee (sre): Locking down temporary quota rules in case of accidental overrides.

telemetry-bot: Final note: We'll attach time-series snippets to the incident doc automatically.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 2191234567: mitigation applied, severity downgraded to P2 for monitoring. No rollback required.
